prompt_en: Photograph an unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties as a private-duty nurse—an unmistakably adult fictional nurse—preserving only the attached reference’s facial appearance: oval face, pale complexion, ash-blonde hair, gray eyes, soft straight brows, and full pink lips. In an after-hours treatment room, she holds a capped syringe beside one clearly adult patient identified by a cobalt wristband, the same adult counterpart. Her tender professional smile is meant for that same patient. Genuine tenderness shapes a slightly asymmetric tender smile; target-locked eye-head-body attention fixes on him. She quietly turns the door lock with her free hand and appropriates access. A brief tremor in her smile, revealing possessive devotion at the instant the lock clicks; the red locked indicator already glows and the patient’s hand has tightened around the chair arm. His choice has visibly narrowed. Obsessive love and barely controlled frenzy coexist on her face. All signals coexist in one frame. Keep the same cobalt wristband visible in the reflection for continuity. Use cool fluorescent ambience, a warm exam lamp, shallow depth of field, and crisp editorial realism.
